The possibility of not fully recovering from the fatigue of the QEII Cup. Plus the risk of a first overseas expedition. The worst-case scenario those could bring about...

Yet, watching everyone pursue their dreams,
even at this late hour,
I find myself hesitating to make the decision...

And above all, the guilt that I was the one
who suggested the overseas campaign to
Loves Only You in the first place...
